Chapter 1370 - 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’S Transformation

Chapter 1370: Chapter 1: The Myriad Realms Gate’s Transformation

"Didn’t I die?"

Cang Weiyang was somewhat puzzled, but then relevant information flooded his mind.

"Was it the great time lifeform ’Galaxy’ that resurrected me? Because my cave dwelling was acquired by him?"

Cang Weiyang widened his eyes; he never expected that the cave dwelling he left behind would play such a significant role, becoming the key to his resurrection.

"Thank you, great time lifeform."

Cang Weiyang immediately bowed respectfully in a certain direction to express his gratitude.

He dared not directly gaze upon Lin Yuan’s true form, for with his strength, directly observing a time lifeform’s true form might cause his own mind and will to become distorted and corrupted.

"I’ll send you to the Stone People Clan."

With a thought, Lin Yuan transported Cang Weiyang to the current location of the Stone People Clan.

Stone People Clan’s secret realm.

Cang Weiyang’s figure appeared out of thin air.

"Who is it?"

Cang Yulong, also at the peak of the Mastery Realm, immediately sensed something amiss and appeared nearby in an instant.

"Is it Uncle Weiyang?"

Cang Yulong looked at Cang Weiyang, hardly believing his eyes.

Cang Weiyang held a high status within the Stone People Clan as its previous sole Mastery Realm peak.

Cang Yulong was a junior to Cang Weiyang.

But...

Cang Yulong had already felt the dispersion of Cang Weiyang’s karma; he had perished.

Why would he appear again?

And why would the dispersed karma be forcibly reestablished?

Cang Yulong could hardly believe it.

As someone with deep fortune, he received the legacy of the Great Saint Tuo Dragon when he was weak and survived despite being pursued by the Nine Sword Venerable.

Cang Yulong had seen much during his life, yet this scene was still incredibly shocking.

"Yulong, it was the great time lifeform that resurrected me."

Cang Weiyang promptly explained.

"Great time lifeform?"

Cang Yulong took a deep breath.

Great time lifeform.

Indeed.

Only a great time lifeform could resurrect someone of the Twelfth Layer.

"The cave dwelling I left behind was acquired by the great time lifeform, which granted me this favor and led to my resurrection."

Cang Weiyang said with a smile.

"Is it the Galaxy Great Saint?"

Cang Yulong murmured to himself.

If it were an ancient time lifeform aiming to resurrect Cang Weiyang, they would have done so long ago.

There would be no need to wait until now.

Hence, the time lifeform resurrecting Cang Weiyang must only be a newly advanced time lifeform.

Lately, two time lifeforms had newly advanced.

One is Luo Hou, the other is Galaxy.

Luo Hou is an extremely ancient Great Saint.

With Luo Hou’s strength, he would have no interest in Cang Weiyang’s cave dwelling.

"Galaxy Great Saint?"

Cang Weiyang nodded; the moment he was resurrected, he became aware of Lin Yuan’s title.

"Earlier, when our Stone People Clan was imprisoned by the Nine Sword Venerable, it must have been the work of Galaxy Great Saint too."

Cang Yulong murmured to himself. At that time, he even set Galaxy Great Saint as his goal, driven by the legacy of the Great Saint Tuo Dragon in him.

Looking at it now.

He was not even Chaos Realm.

Galaxy Great Saint had already stepped into the Thirteenth Layer.

Even if he hadn’t stepped into the Thirteenth Layer, the name of Galaxy Great Saint was known throughout the Chaos Void.

...

Outside an isolated, natural cosmos.

A woman wearing a light green skirt appeared.

A burly, majestic male figure appeared in the distance as well.

"Xuan."

The woman in the light green skirt couldn’t help calling out when she saw the burly male.

"Senior sister."

The burly male’s expression was also full of emotion.

"What is this?"

The burly male looked around thoughtfully.

"Xuan, how am I alive?"

The woman in the light green skirt looked slightly confused.

When she died, she was too weak to even be in the Mastery Realm.

"You were resurrected."

"I was resurrected too, by the great time lifeform who captured us."

The burly male ’Xuanhuang’ said softly, lifting his gaze to see a majestic true form gazing down at him.

As an Invincible Great Saint, ’Xuanhuang’ had earned the privilege to look up to the time lifeform.

Using the weapon of the Thirteenth Layer, he forced a break in the time loop, an act destined to lead to certain death.

Only a time lifeform of the Thirteenth Layer could have resurrected him.

But he had no karma with the time lifeform and lacked any value for resurrection; forcibly breaking the time loop meant he would never step into the Thirteenth Layer.

"Live well with your senior sister."

Lin Yuan’s voice echoed beside Xuanhuang.

Xuanhuang’s greatest obsession was his senior sister.

To have her back, he willingly gave up the chance to become the Thirteenth Layer time lifeform.

"Thank you, great time lifeform."

Xuanhuang immediately bowed, understanding that Lin Yuan resurrected his senior sister out of respect for him.

Otherwise, his senior sister had no karma with Lin Yuan; even if she were to be resurrected, it wouldn’t be her turn.

...

"Demon Jade Tower Master..."

Lin Yuan gazed into the deepest part of the Chaos Void, which belonged to the Demon Jade Tower Master’s time loop region.

"No chance of breaking the time loop."

Lin Yuan shook his head lightly.

The possibility of passing the time loop test is greatest the first time through.

With each additional cycle thereafter, the chances diminish.

Now, nearly ten million Cosmic Eras had passed since the Demon Jade Tower Master fell into the time loop.

The Demon Jade Tower Master, caught in the time loop, had likely undergone countless loops, probably unable to even maintain his self, let alone break the time loop itself.

"Break."

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly serious as he forcibly broke through the time loop that the Demon Jade Tower Master had fallen into.

Buzz — the terrifying backlash swept through, yet Lin Yuan easily fended it off.

A figure in a black robe was retrieved by Lin Yuan.

"I..."

Freed from the confines of the time loop, the Demon Jade Tower Master quickly regained his senses, and many memories surged back.

"Thank you, great time lifeform."

The Demon Jade Tower Master immediately bowed to Lin Yuan.

Trapped in the time loop, endlessly looping without self-awareness.

For any Great Saint, this was torment.

Lin Yuan forcibly shattered the time loop, weathering the backlash of the timeline to rescue him, akin to a resurrection.

"Didn’t expect that the casual creation of Demon Jade Space back then would nurture a great time lifeform."

The Demon Jade Tower Master’s heart was filled with emotion, having learned everything after emerging from the time loop.

...

Lasted for about half an hour.

All the fallen strong ones relating to Lin Yuan from past karma were resurrected.

For these resurrected beings, Lin Yuan mostly greeted them, briefly explaining the reason for their revival.

Otherwise, being resurrected inexplicably by a great time lifeform would be dreadfully terrifying for most lifeforms.

"That should be about it."

Lin Yuan retracted his powers, watching over the newly resurrected beings, all with joyous expressions, feeling quite content himself.

When one person steps into the Way, they elevate everyone connected to them.

Upon crossing into the Thirteenth Layer, all life interconnected with his own ought to have a second chance.

Given Lin Yuan’s current strength and foundation, doing such incurred little cost.

Even the backlash from the timeline was easily endured, not affecting him at all.

"Hmm?"

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s expression subtly changed.

He instantly partitioned a portion of his attention, diving deep into his mind.

For now, a mysterious aura began emanating from the grand and magnificent Myriad Realms Gate.
